solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Sort of music college now without women

parts.note: a tech is a technical college

indicators.note: says one letter is dropped from the word beside it

parts.note: taken as written before the cut

explanation.surface: A complaint that some college has no women these days.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes W (women) from NOW, leaving NO.
explanation.definitionFit: Techno is a genre of electronic dance music, so it is one sort of music.

clue.text: Design a format for a battle fought about university

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go around the university abbreviation
the letters of a battle are churned up as in a fight

explanation.surface: Planning a fight's layout around a campus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fought' rearranges A BATTLE to TABLATE; 'about' puts it round U.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging data into rows and columns is giving it a format, i.e. designing a layout.

clue.text: Cook's part supporting fool in church

indicators.note: in a down answer the part lies under the fool-in-church, holding it up
the fool is placed inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
an ass is a fool
a role is a part in a play

explanation.surface: A chef plays the clown's straight man in a church show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cook's' reads as possessive but is 'Cook is'; in a down answer 'supporting' means the part sits underneath.
explanation.definitionFit: To casserole meat is to stew it slowly in a lidded dish, a way to cook.

clue.text: Kiss cheek

definitions.meaning: impudence, nerve, as in having the cheek to do something

explanation.definitionFit: To kiss and cuddle is informally to snog; brass nerve or impudence is also called this.

clue.text: Questions barristers after defence loses heart

indicators.note: places the barristers piece after the defence piece
a word that loses its heart keeps only its first and last letters, here from defence

parts.note: briefs is informal for barristers, who take briefs

explanation.surface: Lawyers cross-examining once the defence case has collapsed.
explanation.walkthrough: Barristers are informally called briefs, after the documents instructing them.
explanation.definitionFit: To debrief is to question someone about a mission, so the verb matches questions.

clue.text: Confer right to half of open championship

indicators.note: the back two of the four letters of the word open

parts.note: a title is a championship

explanation.surface: Granting entry to part of a golf or tennis tournament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half of' gives EN, the second half of open.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone a rightful claim or permission: to confer a right on them.

clue.text: Picture definition of "agreed decision"

definitions.meaning: the sharpness of detail in an image or screen
a formal motion passed by vote

explanation.surface: Seemingly a dictionary entry for a phrase, in quotes.
explanation.walkthrough: The quote marks make 'agreed decision' look like the term defined, but both halves are definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Screen sharpness is measured in pixels; a vote's outcome is a motion carried.

clue.text: Cream of English literature on line at last

indicators.note: the final letter of the word line

explanation.surface: The best English books finally going online.
explanation.definitionFit: The cream of something is its best part, the select top group.

clue.text: Security perhaps covering most of fair

indicators.note: one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: say means for example, perhaps

indicators.note: the word for fair loses its last letter

parts.note: a fete is a fair or gala

explanation.surface: Guards perhaps looking after most of a funfair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' is not a definition marker here: it is the synonym of 'say', as in 'say, ten'.
explanation.definitionFit: Being safe from harm is a state of protection, synonym of security.

clue.text: Shows off very senior relatives

parts.note: aunts are older relatives

explanation.surface: Elderly family members showing off.
explanation.definitionFit: To boast about or flaunt one's achievements is to show off.

clue.text: Skill required for a presidential yacht?

parts.note: Bush is the surname of two US presidents
a craft is a boat, of which a yacht is one kind

explanation.surface: Asking what talent is needed to own a head of state's boat.
explanation.walkthrough: BUSH is a US president's name and a yacht is a craft; the question mark flags the loose 'presidential'.
explanation.definitionFit: Outdoor survival expertise in the wilderness is called this, a kind of practical skill.

clue.text: Formal statement starts argument

indicators.note: the start of the word statement gives its first letter

parts.note: a tiff is a petty quarrel or argument

explanation.surface: An official declaration kicks off a dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Formal statement' looks like one phrase, but 'Formal' is the definition and 'statement starts' gives only S.
explanation.definitionFit: Stiff manners are rigidly correct and starchy, a synonym for formal.

clue.text: Deliberately misrepresented end of insurance in cover

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, the cover wrapping round

parts.note: a lid is a cover for a pot or box

indicators.note: the last letter of the word insurance

explanation.surface: Someone fudged the details of an insurance policy's coverage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end of' takes E from insurance; 'in' puts it inside LID.
explanation.definitionFit: To have told an untruth on purpose is to have deliberately misrepresented things.

clue.text: Part of payment plan making tenant smile (almost)

indicators.note: the letters are used to make something new, signalling a rearrangement
almost all of the word smile, so its final letter goes

explanation.surface: A payment scheme that keeps the renter cheerful, nearly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts SMILE to SMIL; 'making' rearranges TENANT plus SMIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A hire-purchase scheme is paid in regular portions, each one a portion of the plan.

clue.text: Well, bread is an oriental sort of food

parts.note: a spring is a natural source of water, a well
a roll is a small piece of bread

explanation.surface: Bread being declared an Eastern food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Well' looks like an interjection but is the water source.
explanation.definitionFit: A fried pancake roll filled with vegetables is a Chinese starter, an Asian food.

clue.text: Rumour of armed forces finding groups in theatre

indicators.note: a rumour is what is heard, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: troops are soldiers, armed forces

explanation.surface: Gossip about soldiers turning up among stage companies.
explanation.definitionFit: Companies of touring actors or performers are called by this name: groups in theatre.

clue.text: Complete half of ascent with anger

indicators.note: takes the back three of the six letters of ascent

parts.note: ire is anger

explanation.surface: Finishing a climb's second stretch in a temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half of' takes the last half of ascent, ENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Whole and undivided: a synonym for complete as an adjective.

clue.text: Call criminal dealer to provide financial protection

parts.note: to ring is to call by phone
a fence deals in stolen goods

explanation.surface: Phoning a crook to ask for money to protect oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: To ring-fence funds is to reserve them for one purpose, protecting them financially.

clue.text: New GP, yet one developed biological grouping

indicators.note: new letters are made from the old ones, signalling a rearrangement of the three words

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A newly qualified family doctor develops into something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges GP YET ONE; 'developed' has no wordplay job, so it is read as part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A genetic class of organisms sharing a set of genes forms a classification worked out by biologists.

clue.text: Angle covering alien's obsession

indicators.note: one piece goes round another, enclosing it

parts.note: to angle is to fish with a rod
ET, the film extraterrestrial, stands for alien

explanation.surface: An extraterrestrial's fixation on a particular viewpoint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Angle' looks like a noun, a viewpoint, but is the verb meaning to go fishing.
explanation.definitionFit: A fixation or compulsive interest, sometimes sexual: synonym of obsession.

clue.text: Turn, depressed by passionate expert

indicators.note: in a down answer, the turn is pushed below the passionate piece

parts.note: hot means passionate, ardent
a shot or turn is a go at something

explanation.surface: A spell of activity dampened by an ardent person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depressed by' places SHOT beneath HOT in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A highly skilled, successful person is a whizz, an expert.

clue.text: Little weight attached to Tory, oddly, getting whip

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters of the word Tory, first and third

parts.note: an ounce is a small unit of weight

explanation.surface: A minor Conservative heavyweight gets the party whip role.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes T and R from Tory; OUNCE is attached after them.
explanation.definitionFit: To whip a team in sport is to beat them heavily, the same as to thrash.

clue.text: One who believes in starting to think before robbery

indicators.note: puts the first piece ahead of the robbery
the first letter of the word think

parts.note: a heist is a robbery

explanation.surface: A burglar pausing to reflect before the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A believer in a god or gods is one who believes, in a religious sense.

clue.text: Top of cover in new drain is off

indicators.note: the cover letter sits inside the rearranged drain
the letters of drain are made new, rearranged
the first letter of the word cover, the top in a down answer

explanation.surface: A fresh drain has lost its lid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges DRAIN to RANID; 'in' puts C inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Food gone off has spoiled, smelling stale and bad: a synonym in this sense.

clue.text: Completely nude?

definitions.meaning: being in the ... is an idiom for being naked

explanation.surface: Is someone fully unclothed?
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the altogether' is an idiom for naked; the question mark flags that nude is a looser, idiomatic sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Means totally as an adverb, and in the idiom naked.

clue.text: Links welcoming the end of golfer's rows

indicators.note: one piece takes the other inside

parts.note: ties are links or bonds

indicators.note: the final letter of the word golfer

explanation.surface: A golf course greeting a player's quarrels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Links' suggests a golf course but means TIES; 'welcoming' puts R inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Layers stacked one above another, as in a stadium, are rows.

clue.text: A fine run out, but a shock

parts.note: F is the abbreviation for fine, as on pencil leads
RO is the cricket scoring abbreviation for run out

explanation.surface: A batsman's fine innings ended by a run-out comes as a surprise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shock' here is a thick mass of hair, not a surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: A shock of hair is a bushy mass, and an afro is one such hairstyle.

clue.text: So may it be adult workforce?

parts.note: A is the film classification for adult
men are a workforce, the workers

explanation.surface: Asking whether a grown-up labour force is the wish.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hebrew word ending a prayer literally means so be it, an affirmation.

clue.text: Sign stopping progress in company's belief

indicators.note: the sign is placed within the company abbreviation

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company
a red light is the signal that halts traffic

explanation.surface: A firm's creed includes a warning that halts advancement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign stopping progress' is a traffic light at its halting colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A creed or set of principles one holds, so a statement of belief.

clue.text: Liquid mush found in nectar must be a sweetener

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: honey is a sweet nectar

indicators.note: something liquid flows and changes shape, so the letters of mush are rearranged

explanation.surface: Runny goo inside nectar must be what makes it sweet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Liquid' makes USHM; 'sweetener' is slang for a bribe, not sugar.
explanation.definitionFit: A bribe to keep quiet is a sweetener in the slang sense of an inducement.

clue.text: Fail to return during assignation, upset

indicators.note: one piece occurs within the other

parts.note: a date is a romantic appointment

indicators.note: the word for failing is read backwards

parts.note: to lose is to fail to win

explanation.surface: Being stood up on a date leaves one upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to return' makes ESOL; 'upset' is the adjective, miserable, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Desolate means miserable and forlorn, a strong synonym of upset.

clue.text: A former girlfriend is on the phone in the extension

indicators.note: a phone carries only speech, so the words are taken by sound

parts.note: an ex is a former partner, giving the phrase an ex

explanation.surface: An old flame is calling from the other room.
explanation.walkthrough: Said aloud, 'an ex' sounds the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A building added on to a main one, synonym for an extension.
